gen-gf-unica-one-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans keeps its curves generous and its lowercase standing tall, which gives text a lifted, open look. And Unica One above it draws every stroke at a single thickness, so the heading feels cut rather than written.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-matangi: Twine-thick strokes, rounded and left open. Matangi gives the body a hefty lowercase, and Unica One's commanding, uniform lines make the sharpest single quality of the pair: a firm headline over soft, chunky text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-maven-pro: Unica One stands out for its very large lowercase eye and the daylight inside every curve, all drawn with a single stroke. Maven Pro, meanwhile, is the gentler reader, with a welcoming gap in its c.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-michroma: Michroma reads with a wide berth around each letter, tall-bodied and a little stubby at the ascender tips. And across a full page, Unica One's flat fineliner line above it keeps that spaced-out texture feeling deliberate and modern.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-miriam-libre:
Miriam Libre reads like drawn wire, sturdy and friendly.

Unica One takes the heading with its commanding, uniform lines, and the two sit together with the heading firmly cut and the text standing tall beneath it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mochiy-pop-one:
Distinctive, in a hard-edged way, is Unica One.

Mochiy Pop One hangs its big-eyed letters along the line like clothespins, so the two sit together with a cut-sheet heading above text that feels playful but still orderly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Crisp, commanding heading, then wide-spaced text underneath. Mochiy Pop P One brings a sizable lowercase and no brush-like swell, which is what lets Unica One's uniform strokes feel like its natural partner.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-montserrat-underline: Unica One opens the pair with a very large lowercase eye and strokes drawn at one thickness throughout. Montserrat Underline follows with oversized lowercase and round bowls that never swell.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mozilla-headline:
Unica One leads with commanding, uniform strokes.

Mozilla Headline follows with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so a longer passage would read approachable and sturdy rather than stiff.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mozilla-text: Cut-out strokes, like a router bit of fixed width, give Unica One a hard, distinctive edge up top. Mozilla Text runs on with tall bodies and flared terminals, so extended reading looks bold yet stays steady.
